arxiv-2104-02884.title: Spin-helical detection in a semiconductor quantum device with ferromagnetic contacts
arxiv-2104-02884.creator: Zedong Yang, Paul A. Crowell, Vlad S. Pribiag
arxiv-2104-02884.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zedong Yang, Paul A. Crowell, Vlad S. Pribiag. Spin-helical states, which arise in quasi-one-dimensional (1D) channels with spin-orbital (SO) coupling, underpin efforts to realize topologically-protected quantum bits based on Majorana modes in semiconductor nanowires. Detecting helical states is challenging due to non-idealities present in real devices. Here we show by means of tight-binding calculations that by using ferromagnetic contacts it is possible to detect helical modes with high sensitivity even in the presence of realistic device effects, such as quantum interference.

arxiv-2105-01945.title: TESS and HARPS reveal two sub-Neptunes around TOI 1062
arxiv-2105-01945.creator: J. F. Otegi 1,2, F. Bouchy 1, R. Helled 2, D.J. Armstrong 19,20, M. Stalport 1, K.G. Stassun 13, E. Delgado-Mena 17, N.C. Santos 17,18, J.B. Delisle 1, N.C. Hara 1, K. Collins 7, S. Gandhi 19,20, C. Dorn 2, M. Brogi 19,20, M. Fridlund 24,25, H.P. Osborn 23, S. Hoyer 26, S. Udry 1, S. Hojjatpanah 17,
arxiv-2105-01945.description: Abstract The Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite ( TESS ) mission was designed to perform an all-sky search of planets around bright and nearby stars. Here we report the discovery of two sub-Neptunes orbiting around the TOI 1062 (TIC 299799658), a V=10.25 G9V star observed in the TESS Sectors 1, 13, 27 & 28.

arxiv-2204-14004.title: A simple algorithm for uniform sampling on the surface of a hypersphere
arxiv-2204-14004.creator: Stefan Schnabel, Wolfhard Janke
arxiv-2204-14004.description: Abstract We propose a simple method for uniform sampling of points on the surface of a hypersphere in arbitrarily many dimensions. By avoiding the evaluation of computationally expensive functions like logarithms, sines, cosines, or higher-order roots the new method is faster than alternative techniques.

arxiv-2404-05277.title: Dynkin abelianisations of flag varieties
arxiv-2404-05277.creator: Shreepranav Varma Enugandla, Xin Fang, Ghislain Fourier and Christian Steinert
arxiv-2404-05277.description: Abstract . Cerulli Irelli and Lanini have shown that PBW degenerations of flag varieties in type 𝙰 \tt A and 𝙲 \tt C are actually Schubert varieties of higher rank. We introduce Dynkin cones to parameterise specific abelianisations of classical Lie algebras.

arxiv-2503-02472.title: Quantum work extraction of a moving battery as a witness to Unruh thermality in high-dimensional spacetimes
arxiv-2503-02472.creator: Yan Chen, Wei-Wei Zhang, Tian-Xi Ren, Xiang Hao
arxiv-2503-02472.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yan Chen, Wei-Wei Zhang, Tian-Xi Ren, Xiang Hao. We put forward a physical model of a uniformly accelerated Unruh-DeWitt battery and use quantum work extraction as a probe to witness the thermal nature of the Unruh effect in a high dimensional Minkowski spacetime. By means of the open quantum system approach, we investigate the maximal amount of quantum work extraction with respect to the acceleration-induced Unruh temperature, spacetime dimensionality and field mass.

pmc-10572566.title: The Local Anaesthetic Procaine Prodrugs ProcCluster® and Procaine Hydrochloride Impair SARS-CoV-2 Replication and Egress In Vitro
pmc-10572566.creator: Clio Häring, Johannes Jungwirth, Josefine Schroeder, Bettina Löffler, Beatrice Engert, Christina Ehrhardt
pmc-10572566.description: As vaccination efforts against SARS-CoV-2 progress in many countries, there is still an urgent need for efficient antiviral treatment strategies for those with severer disease courses, and lately, considerable efforts have been undertaken to repurpose existing drugs as antivirals. The local anaesthetic procaine has been investigated for antiviral properties against several viruses over the past decades.

pmc-11461627.title: 3D built virtual arctic environment increase vigor through connectedness in older people
pmc-11461627.creator: Davide Clemente, Luciano Romano, Claudia Russo, Giuseppe Carrus, Angelo Panno
pmc-11461627.description: While the life expectancy of older people has increased significantly, this is often related to more long-term care in healthcare residences and nursing homes. Staying in these facilities can lead to a reduction in the sense of connection with others and the world around, as well as in vigor, with significant psychophysical repercussions in the long term.

pmc-12540190.title: Aortic Dissection Complicated With Superior Mesenteric Artery Aneurysm
pmc-12540190.creator: Hisato Takagi
pmc-12540190.description: A case of acute type B aortic dissection (intramural hematoma) complicated by superior mesenteric artery aneurysm is herein reported. It is suggested that the coexistence of aortic dissection and superior mesenteric artery aneurysm should be based upon the shared etiology.

pmc-12606984.title: Clinical-genetic profiles and risk prediction model in childhood restrictive cardiomyopathy: a national cohort study of China
pmc-12606984.creator: Hao Chen, Shushui Wang, Junjun Quan, Wenhong Ding, Cong Liu, Hua Peng, Juanli Wang, Yanyan Xiao, Zipu Li, Hong Wang, Lu Gao, Lin Shi, Yifei Li, Shiwei Yang, Li Zhang, Yulu Huang, Piaohong Liang, Qing Guo, Jian Li, Guangsong Shan, Hongwei Zhang, Xiaoliang Liu, Han Zhang, Wei Li, Bing Zhang, Chengchen
pmc-12606984.description: BackgroundUnderstanding restrictive cardiomyopathy (RCM) in children is limited, and currently, no prognostic model is available for assessing risk stratification in pediatric RCM. The authors elaborated on the clinical and genetic characteristics of pediatric RCM and developed a prediction model to assess the 1-year risk of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), aiding in determining the optimal timing for heart transplantation (HTx).

pmc-13052300.title: Sacral Herpes Zoster Mimicking Pressure Ulcers and Causing Elsberg Syndrome
pmc-13052300.creator: Junya Yamada, Akihito Yoshida, Takaaki Kobayashi, Satomi Kawamura, Sanami Doi, Tadashi Eguchi
pmc-13052300.description: A 90‐year‐old woman presented with sacral skin lesions that were initially misdiagnosed as pressure ulcers. A non‐contrast abdominopelvic computed tomography revealed urinary retention, prompting further evaluation and leading to the diagnosis of sacral herpes zoster complicated by Elsberg syndrome. The patient was treated with antiviral therapy, and her urinary function gradually improved, with successful catheter removal by day 20.

pmc-13151782.title: The Effectiveness of Artificial Intelligence in Undergraduate Health Professions Education: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-13151782.creator: Nai Ming Lai, Yin Sear Lim, Min Thein Win, Prabal Bhargava, Paraidathathu Thomas, Qi Chwen Ong
pmc-13151782.description: BackgroundHealth professions education faces increasing challenges from rising health care complexity, pedagogical shifts, and constrained curricular space, and rapidly expanding knowledge and technological advances. While artificial intelligence (AI) shows promise for transforming health professions education, evidence of its effectiveness remains unclear.ObjectiveThis study synthesized evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) on the effectiveness of AI in undergraduate health professions education.

pmc-13583161.title: Outcome of Acute Myeloid Leukemia Treatment and Isocitrate Dehydrogenase (IDH) Mutations: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis Study
pmc-13583161.creator: Fereshteh Ameli, Alireza Abdollahi, Samaneh Salarvand, Dorsa Ghasemi
pmc-13583161.description: Background: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a heterogeneous disease with diverse genetic alterations that influence prognosis and treatment outcomes. Isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) genes, particularly IDH1 and IDH2, have emerged as important prognostic biomarkers, but the impact of their mutations on survival remains controversial.

pmc-13615783.title: Leaf nutrients regulate phyllosphere microbial dynamics in rubber trees
pmc-13615783.creator: Jiao Sun, Yaqing Wei, Yanjun Du, Guoyu Lan
pmc-13615783.description: Mechanisms underlying the assembly and succession of phyllosphere microbiota in rubber plantations are crucial for understanding ecosystem health and functionality, yet poorly understood. In this study, high-throughput sequencing was used to analyze the diversity, assembly mechanisms, and potential sources of phyllosphere microbial communities at developmental stages.
